_comment: Catalog of joinable classes. A professor (later: professor dashboard) publishes a class here with a join CODE; students add it by entering the code. Each lesson lists its syllabus chapter reference and the exact problem numbers assigned that week — the length of `problems` is the lesson's grade target (how many the syllabus expects).
